ASX Announcement
BrainChip Announces Commercial Availability
of Sequora™ Edge AI Processor IP
Sydney, Australia – 14 October 2026 – BrainChip Holdings Ltd (ASX: BRN, OTCQX: BRCHF,
BCHPY) a global leader in ultra-low power, fully digital, event-based neuromorphic AI, advises that
its Sequora™ processor intellectual property (IP) core has completed development and is now
available for commercial licensing to semiconductor and system developers.
Sequora is designed to enable generative AI workloads for edge-based applications where power
efficiency, memory utilisation and local processing capabilities are important design
considerations.
Sean Hehir, BrainChip’s CEO, stated: “Sequora is an important next step in our technology
roadmap, and is being delivered to the timeline outlined in our May 2026 roadmap presentation.
“The availability of Sequora expands BrainChip's product portfolio and addresses applications
requiring generative AI capabilities within edge devices. Potential application areas include
industrial, automotive, aerospace and defence, consumer and medical markets.”
Sequora is being offered as semiconductor IP licensed to customers to incorporate into their own
system-on-chip designs. The commercial offering includes a comprehensive suite of related
software and development tools.
Sequora provides significant edge AI advantages on the one piece of silicon:
• Maintains existing Akida advantages
o Continues to run on ultra-low power maximising battery life
o Does not rely on cloud connection – maintaining data sovereignty and high speed
computation, while minimising cloud costs
• Delivers additional capabilities
o Brings Generative AI and LLM capabilities to the device
o Supports model sizes up to ~3 billion parameters
o Expands model capabilities that are currently limited by battery size
o Enhances run-time branching to enable automotive, medical and avionics

About BrainChip Holdings Ltd (ASX: BRN, OTCQX: BRCHF, ADR: BCHPY)
BrainChip is the worldwide leader in Edge AI on-chip processing and learning. The company’s first-to-market, fully digital, event-based
AI processor, Akida™, uses neuromorphic principles to mimic the human brain, analysing only essential sensor inputs at the point of
acquisition and processing data with unmatched efficiency, precision, and energy economy. BrainChip’s Temporal Event-based Neural
Networks (TENNs) build on State-Space Models (SSMs), deliver time-aware, event-driven intelligence optimized for scalable, real-time
streaming applications. These innovations make low-power Edge AI deployable across industries such as aerospace, autonomous
vehicles, robotics, industrial IoT, consumer devices, and wearables. BrainChip is advancing the future of intelligent computing, bringing
AI closer to the sensor and closer to real-time.
